newsitem.title: USA: Seagram names new head of external affairs.
newsitem.headline: Seagram names new head of external affairs.

text.p: Joseph E Seagram & Sons Inc, a unit of Seagram Co Ltd, said Wednesday it named William Roesing vice president, external affairs, effective July 1.
He replaces the retiring Steve Herbits.
Roesing will be responsible for external affairs and policy for the beverage and entertainment businesses worldwide as well as the company as a whole.
The company said he will also oversee corporate policy related to political and marketplace issues, including advertising.
Since 1993, Roesing has been vice president of public policy for Seagram, the company said.
